name: Mobile Device
description: A mobile device — also called a smartphone, tablet, iOS/Android device, BYOD handset, or the consumer's phone — an untrusted, unmanaged endpoint running the system's app or accessing it via browser. Holds tokens and credentials locally and operates fully outside organizational management. The place to look for the mobile device, phone/tablet, iOS/Android client, or the user's personal handheld accessing the system.
